notes.title: Monterona DEMO is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[b]The first demo is out now![/b]

Even though this demo contains just a small fraction of the final content, I hope you'll enjoy it, and I'm thrilled to hear your feedback.

Please consider adding Monterona to your wishlist and following the game development on Twitter or TikTok. Have fun!
